arStrings.szText: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Shadow damage has up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} chance to release an explosion that deals {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Cold damage to the target and surrounding enemies, {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} them for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.
Shadow damage can explode for Cold damage, {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} enemies hit for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.
